description: This file implements an extended Active Record pattern for PHP, providing classes and functions for managing database records, relationships, and caching within a PHP project using ADODB. It includes definitions for Active Record classes, relation management (hasMany, belongsTo), metadata handling, and caching strategies.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_DB
classes.description: Represents a database connection with multiple active record tables.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Table
classes.description: Represents metadata of a database table, including columns, keys, and relationships.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Record
classes.description: Base class for encapsulating a database record with methods for CRUD operations, relation management, and metadata handling.

methods.name: ADODB_SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Associates a database connection with an internal registry and returns its index.

methods.name: UseDefaultValues
methods.description: Static method to set or get the default value usage flag for Active Record instances.

methods.name: SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Static method to assign a database connection to the Active Record system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing an Active Record object with optional table name, primary key array, database connection, and options.

methods.name: UpdateActiveTable
methods.description: Refreshes or loads the table metadata including columns, keys, and caching.

methods.name: hasMany
methods.description: Defines a one-to-many relationship with another table.

methods.name: belongsTo
methods.description: Defines a many-to-one relationship with another table.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Lazy loads related records or properties.

methods.name: LoadRelations
methods.description: Loads related records based on relationship definitions.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a record (or records) from the database with optional relations.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Persists the current record to the database, performing insert or update.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the database and updates the object's primary key.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the current record from the database.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds records matching a criteria and returns an array of objects.

methods.name: Replace
methods.description: Replaces or inserts a record, handling auto-increment keys.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing record in the database if data has changed.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Handles errors, logging error messages for debugging.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number.

methods.name: DB
methods.description: Retrieves the database connection object.

methods.name: TableInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata about the associated table.

methods.name: Reload
methods.description: Reloads the current record from the database.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets object properties based on a data array or row.

methods.name: LastInsertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID for auto-increment keys.

methods.name: doQuote
methods.description: Quotes and sanitizes values for SQL WHERE clauses.

methods.name: GenWhere
methods.description: Generates SQL WHERE clause based on primary keys.
